claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show blue plastic drums with bung holes and closed ends, consistent with liquid storage, but not suitability for every liquid type.
Food-grade status is not shown in any photo.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Usage history and previous contents are not shown in any photo.
Cracks, leaks, and damage are not shown in any photo.
Lid and bung completeness is not shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Capacity or volume in litres is unknown
risks.proof: Close-up photo of drum embossing or label showing litres, or a measuring tape beside a drum

risks.risk: Drums may be used rather than new
risks.proof: Close-up of interior and exterior wear, manufacturing date, or seller usage record

risks.risk: Leaks, cracks, or damage may be present
risks.proof: Video of a drum filled with water and inspected at seams and bung holes

risks.risk: Lids and bungs may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing lids and bungs with the drums or packed separately

risks.risk: Previous contents may be non-food-grade or hazardous
risks.proof: Label or documentation showing food-grade status and prior contents

risks.risk: Interior may be dirty or contaminated
risks.proof: Interior photo or video with a light source showing cleanliness

proof_requests: Close-up of drum markings showing capacity in litres
Video of a drum filled with water to check for leaks and cracks
Photo showing lids and bungs included with the drums
Interior photo or video showing cleanliness
Label or documentation confirming food-grade status and previous contents
response.reason: The witness identifies blue plastic drums, so a worst-case price is possible; all condition and grade claims are unproven remotely and are priced as defective until proven otherwise.
